facts.fact: Warranty: 3 + 7 years: heater + elements. Bromic: Three years on the heater and seven on the elements, across Select, Coastal and Classic. Infratech: A 3-year limited warranty; a fourth year through Elite Retailers and the Installer Program.

facts.fact: Recessed, dual fan-ventilated: 6 kW recessed, two fans in the kit. Bromic: 6,000 W into a 7.5 in ceiling cavity (to confirm). The low-clearance kit is dual fan-ventilated and the recess box comes with it. Infratech: Flush frames sit in a framed 2×8 pocket lined on five sides with Type X drywall; no fans are shown.

facts.fact: Pitched ceilings and tilt: 3/12–12/12 pitched-ceiling range. Bromic: Mounts to a pitched ceiling with its adaptor, and to a wall, extended wall or single post; tilts up to 45° (4 and 6 kW: to confirm). Infratech: Its flush frame "is ONLY to be used on a flat non-sloped ceiling".

facts.fact: One finish, front included: 3 finishes, the front in the same one. Bromic: All black, all white or all graphite, front included; three front patterns swap without re-wiring. Infratech: Eight powder-coat colours plus custom on the housing; the reflector face and wire guard stay stainless.

facts.fact: Smart controls and app: 1% dimming steps in the Bromic app. Bromic: Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls: zones, schedules, timers, remote off, Alexa and Google Assistant. Wi-Fi and app features need compatible Affinity controls, sold separately. Infratech: App control through Bond: a Smart Dimmer with its control panel, or a Smart Switch for on/off with a 2-hour timer.

facts.fact: Start With The Ceiling: Ask where the heat will mount. Flat, pitched from 3/12 to 12/12, or recessed: Series II recesses 6,000 W with a dual fan-ventilated kit and the recess box supplied. Infratech recesses 6 kW too; its flush frame needs a lined 2×8 pocket on a flat ceiling, and its drawing says: "After 4 hours of continuous use, a 15 minute cool down period is recommended".

facts.fact: Show The Whole Heater: Black, white or graphite carries through to the front, with three front patterns that swap without re-wiring. If the customer wants a specific colour, Infratech offers eight plus custom: say so, then show how the Bromic heater reads as one piece.
